the_label_is_wrong_for_what_happened.what_actually_happened: the Slow draw never reached the deterministic controller.  The agent core rejected the model's envelope, issued its two static feedback retries, and the third response was still not a valid agent-envelope/1.  Three LLM calls, one draw, no proposal, no EditController call.
the_label_is_wrong_for_what_happened.not_in_the_pre_registered_set: B5 offers BANKED_CHAIN_CLOSES / ATTRIBUTION_STILL_MISSES / SLOW_DECLINES / COMPILER_REJECTS / REPLAY_NO_CHANGE.  This is none of them: the Agent did not decline, and the compiler did not refuse anything.
the_label_is_wrong_for_what_happened.why_it_was_mislabelled: stage_slow classifies any non-transport exception from core.run_stage as COMPILER_REJECTS.  That was right in #21, where the exception really did come from the controller, and is wrong here.  A reporting defect in this runner, on the same family as the three already on file.
the_label_is_wrong_for_what_happened.consequence_to_state_plainly: COMPILER_REJECTS would suggest #22's maxLength repair failed.  It did not: the compiler was never reached, so the repair is still untested end to end on a live draw.
